But "徇私舞弊" is not listed. However, there is a label "滥用职权" (abuse of power). In the earlier example for "受贿;滥用职权" they used both. The correction lessons: "Correct label 【受贿;滥用职权】 (not ...)" So "滥用职权" is a valid label.
